name: analyze-sentiment
description: Analyze Olist review sentiment using model-level NLP scores over Portuguese review text. Use for negative review analysis, customer satisfaction, bad-review categories, seller review diagnostics, and structured review insight for BI decisions. For Top 10 bad review categories and reasons, call this skill with min_score=1 and max_score=2 after or alongside extract_keywords. The skill reads review_sentiment_scores and can call the configured LLM to incrementally fill missing sentiment rows for the current business slice. Do NOT probe schema with SHOW, information_schema, or exploratory sql_query.
author: xyppyx
